summary: Independently re-verified the hero deep-link → OTP flow fix (no 'Create your account' flash). All 9 requested scenarios pass. Tests were run against the live preview with POST **/api/user/registerEmail intercepted via Playwright page.route() — no real OTPs reached the production backend. Verify-otp and complete endpoints were also intercepted.

T1_desktop_1920_account_exists_false.after_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to qa***@example.com (data-sending=false)

T2_mobile_390.notes: Subtitle wraps to 2 lines on 390px; spinner is correctly placed inline with the masked email on line 2 (verified via DOM containment + vertical overlap).

T4_failure_fallback_429.server_error_shown: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

T8_hero_invalid_email_validation.error_text: Please enter a valid email address.

T9_i18n_french.subtitle_text: Envoi d’un code à 6 chiffres à qa***@example.com

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is functioning as designed: hero deep-link navigates straight to /auth/register with ref=hero&autoSend=1 and the verify (OTP) step is rendered immediately — the email form is never mounted during the autoSend path (verified via 40ms DOM polling from click to OTP title). The sendSeqRef stale-response guard correctly prevents a late slow response from yanking the user back to OTP after 'Change email'.
seed_data_creation: None. All POST /api/user/registerEmail requests were intercepted and mocked at the Playwright layer — no live DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The fix is correct. page.route('**/api/user/registerEmail') MUST be installed before any navigation in each scenario to protect the live production DB. The mobile spinner-same-line assertion requires checking DOM containment (sub.contains(spinner)) + vertical overlap rather than exact top-line equality, because the subtitle wraps to two lines on 390px (the spinner sits on line 2 next to the masked email, which is the intended design).
rca of the issue: N/A — this run verifies the already-shipped fix. The original UX bug (flash of 'Create your account' between landing hero and OTP) is no longer reproducible: the register page reads ref=hero&autoSend=1 from the URL and mounts directly on step='verify', firing exactly one registerEmail request with a sending-state subtitle+spinner, then swaps to the standard OTP subtitle on response (or falls back to the email form with prefilled value + inline error on failure).
